annotation_policy: Each annotated written occurrence links to existing definition IDs. Unannotated tokens mean no supervised alignment in this corpus, never meaningless text. Context labels are authored, not independent semantic adjudication. Root-origin definitions are used only in explicit metalinguistic contexts.
split_policy: Separate authored sentence groups; fixed before fitting; test never enters gradients, calibration or checkpoint selection. Known concepts only, no unseen-sense claim.
